page.overview:
Who is Bowenn?

Bowenn was a male Human captain of the reconstituted Sith Empire stationed on Balmorra during the Cold War. Commanding Imperial defenses around the Balmorran Arms Factory, he executed a spy, Danak, that was delivered to him by a local Imperial sympathizer named Ivo.
